title: Review of the CIPS consumer claim on fresh seed 41: S, X and E replicate; consumer splits are the prey's own pinching (34/36 simultaneous), and only 10 of 679 consumer tracks live 2000 t
summary: labkit runs of the claimed world on fresh seed 41 (128^2, t=12000, --lineage-k 5), its consumer-free twin and the prey-removal fork (tcut 3000). The twin is frozen (76 prey, 5 persistent splits, 0 moving tracks) against 39 prey, 84-87 persistent prey splits, generation 9 with consumers; the fork takes consumers 29 -> 0 within 100 t. Applying the same measurements I made for c52's predators (coinc.py, partners.py): 34 of 36 persistent consumer splits coincide (within one frame, 20 px) with a prey split, against 3 of 36 for c52's predators; 0 labkit-persistent consumer tracks and only 10 of 679 consumer tracks live >= 20 frames, against 306 for c52. splits.png shows the consumer as a band on the concave edge of a prey crescent that is cut in two when the crescent pinches.

observations.S: rerun/seed41/sheet.png t=0: noise over the whole domain; prey droplets and consumer bands form from it.
observations.X: rerun/twin_seed41/metrics.json (pred_on 0, same seed, grid, duration, window): prey 76 bodies, 5 persistent splits, generation 1, 0 moving tracks; with consumers (rerun/seed41/metrics.json) 39 prey, 87 persistent splits, generation 9, 127 moving tracks.
observations.E: rerun/efork_seed41 (tcut 3000): consumer bodies (render c_q > 0.5) 29 at t=3000, 0 at t=3100, max rendered q 1.04 -> 0.08 by t=3500; the fed run (rerun/seed41) keeps ~30-35.

seeds_run.result: pass for S, X and E; consumer I and D not met: 0 persistent consumer tracks, 10/679 consumer tracks >= 2000 t, 34/36 consumer splits simultaneous with a prey split

verdicts.limitation: I and D are not supported for the consumer: it is a band on the edge of a prey crescent (touching prey in 82-100% of sampled frames) that is cut with the prey when the crescent pinches (34/36 persistent consumer splits within one frame of a prey split; splits.png), and consumer tracks rarely live 2000 t. The prey's own division is real (87 persistent splits) but needs the consumer (twin: 5). One seed, no dt or grid variant.
